en.answer: Even if you have 2 copies of <<11931>> on your side of the field, each of their first effects will be applied the first time a card on your side of the field would be destroyed by battle or by card effect, which means that card will be destroyed normally the second time it would be destroyed. (The result is the same as if you only had 1 copy of <<11931>>.)
en.question: If I have 2 copies of <<11931>> on my side of the field, how are each of their first effects applied?
en.title: If I have 2 copies of <<11931>> on my side of the field, how are each of their first effects applied?

ja.answer:
自分のモンスターゾーンに「<<11931>>」が2体表側表示で存在する場合、自分フィールドのカードが破壊される際に、それぞれの『①：自分フィールドのカードはそれぞれ１ターンに１度だけ戦闘・効果では破壊されない』効果が適用される事になりますので、そのカードが2度目に戦闘や効果で破壊される際には通常通り破壊される事になります。
（「<<11931>>」が1体のみ存在している場合と変わりません。）
